set: A: the page at rest in four screens, its key, and native crops of its text and controls

issues.what: in the resting state the line is sliced mid-word at the container edge ("Company Retreat: One S..."), so if nothing moves it reads as text overflow rather than a marquee
issues.fix: pad the loop and add left/right fade masks or ellipses, or choose a rest frame that ends on a complete item

issues.where: nav links and small helper/fine-print text in the native-size crops
issues.what: the warm-grey secondary text is readable but sits close to the contrast floor for small text on the paper background
issues.fix: darken secondary text one step while keeping primary headings and CTA unchanged

issues.where: three benefit cards in the rest state
issues.what: the cards are large and mostly empty until the later moment fills the lower area, so a purely static reading feels slightly underfilled
issues.fix: either keep the title/body position stable and let the card grow for the reveal, or shorten the resting card height
